description.from:
Replace the ALERT#<listId>/ITEM#<lineageId> de-dup rows and the alert issue. dedupeKey story-published:<lineageId> plus the email Delivery's audience. The alert's Markus body moves to the Delivery's text file in S3. Kept alert rows are converted (keys only) so each becomes an Announcement with a sent email Delivery and nothing alerts twice. The notifications story.published event becomes the first attempt of the email Delivery. Follows the Caducus move.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Kept alert rows still prevent a second alert after conversion.
- Gherkin: Fan-out counts (counts match Caducus records; a reader on two lists gets one message).
- Conversion command is idempotent.
- Operator alarms are not Announcements and stay plain Caducus events.

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.

**Always-on agent standard (2026-11-16; design `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md`)**
An alert list is a list with cadence `each` (PPY-4d74d9). A reader holds one cadence per family, so nobody gets an item both singly and in the daily summary (PPY-a19b9d). Quiet hours and spacing are PPY-769d1b. Now also blocked by PPY-4d74d9.
